description: Get the quality grade (A-D) for a supplement based on bioavailability, filler detection, and NIH verification. Use this when a user asks about supplement quality, which form is best, whether a supplement has concerning fillers, or wants to compare brands.

other_ingredients.description: Other ingredients text from the label for filler detection. Optional.

supplement.description: Supplement name to grade. e.g. 'Magnesium Oxide' or 'NOW Foods Vitamin D3 5000IU'

name: grade_supplement_quality
